question: Lemons are bought at the rate of 3 for Rs 2 and sold at the rate of 2 for Rs 3. Find the profit percentage.
solution:
Given:

CP of 3 Lemons = Rs 2

SP of 2 Lemons = Rs. 3 

Formula used:

Gain = SP – CP SP

Gain% = Gain/CP × 100

Calculation:

CP of 3 Lemons = Rs 2

CP of 1 Lemons = Rs. 2/3

SP of 2 Lemons = Rs. 3 

SP of 1 Lemons = Rs. 3/2

Now,

Gain = Rs. (3/2 – 2/3)

⇒ (9 – 4)/6

⇒ 5/6

Now,

Gain% = [(5/6)/(2/3) × 100]

⇒ (5/6 × 3/2 × 100)

⇒ (5 × 25)%

⇒ 125%

∴ The percentage gain is 125%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Make the quantity purchased and sold equal.

3 lemons bought for → Rs. 2

6 lemons bought for → Rs. 4

2 lemons sold for → Rs. 3

6 lemons sold for → Rs. 9

Gain% = [(9 - 4)/(4) × 100] ⇒ (1.25 × 100)% ⇒ 125%
